newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish banking sector profits decline in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Polish banking sector profits decline in Q1.

text.p: Total profits of Polish banks fell in the first quarter of 1997 compared with the same period of last year, depressed by higher operating costs, a Central Statistical Office (GUS) report showed on Friday.

GUS said aggregate pre-tax profit of 82 Polish commercial banks fell to 1.9 billion zlotys from 2.1 billion zlotys, while total net profit fell in the same period to 1.37 billion zlotys from 1.55 billion last year.
GUS said an increase in interest costs and operating costs depressed banks' results despite higher interest and commission revenues.
The report said that also an increase in obligatory reserve requirements contributed to the profits decline.
